title: Find Character (f, t)
instruction_text:
Jump to any character on the current line!

'f{char}' = find char (cursor ON the character)
't{char}' = till char (cursor BEFORE the character)
';' = repeat last f/t forward
',' = repeat last f/t backward

Your task: Remove all commas from the text.

Steps:
1. Press 'f,' to jump to first comma
2. Press 'x' to delete it
3. Press ';' to jump to next comma
4. Press '.' to repeat the deletion
5. Repeat ';' then '.' for remaining commas
6. Save with :wq

Tip: 'df,' deletes through comma, 'dt,' deletes up to comma.
